create_glm4v_model: create a GLM4VForCausalLM multimodal model with vLLM config for image-text generation
build_eva2clip_model: build an EVA2CLIPModel vision encoder that processes images into embeddings with patch embedding and transformer layers
process_glm4v_images: process image inputs through the GLM4V vision encoder and return multimodal embeddings for the language model
configure_glm4v_processor: configure a GLM4VMultiModalProcessor to handle image token replacement and prompt updates for GLM4V
compute_mrope_positions: compute multi-axis rotary position embeddings (MRoPE) for image and text tokens in GLM4V inference
